articles.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Expands AI Security Push With Two New Enterprise Tie Ups
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS: CSCO) is working with DXC Technology to integrate Cisco AgenticOps into the DXC OASIS platform for enterprise IT automation. The firm is also partnering with Qumulo on a joint ransomware defense solution that combines Cisco Hypershield with N9300 Smart Switches. Both collaborations focus on AI driven automation and security for large IT environments, adding fresh detail to Cisco's broader AI push.
